subject: Stakeholder mapping + next steps (FinovateBank)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Asha Patel <asha.patel@finovatebank.com>, Chris Morgan <chris.morgan@finovatebank.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Stakeholder mapping + next steps (FinovateBank)

Hi Asha / Chris —

Thanks again for a great discovery call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we don’t lose momentum: 

Key decision criteria you mentioned:
- Predictable per-token costs and clear unit economics for customer-facing features
- Low tail latency for short user-facing responses (target p95 < 200ms)
- Data isolation and audit logs for regulated flows
- Ability to pin model versions & rollback safely for compliance

Open items / asks we agreed on:
1) Stakeholder map: can you confirm the list below (role, name, email, priority)? I put placeholders where we discussed names.
   - Economic buyer (Budget/Approval): Evan Briggs — CFO? (confirm)
   - Security & Privacy: Security team (we heard Laura’s team will own this) — please share contact
   - Procurement: procurement@finovatebank.com (confirmed during call)
   - Product/Platform champion: Asha Patel (you)

2) Procurement & security materials you want: SOC 2, data retention, technical architecture, and a short ROI summary — we’ll attach initial stubs below.

3) Next demo / technical deep-dive: Naomi (solutions) and David (CS) can run a 45-min session focused on throughput, latency SLOs, and integration patterns. Proposed times next week?

I’ve attached a first-draft mutual action plan (MAP_FinovateBank_v1.xlsx) that lays out milestones for procurement, security review, pilot, and rollout. If you can fill in the stakeholder names/owners and target dates that’ll help us sync with our ops.

Attachments: MAP_FinovateBank_v1.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to the next steps.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
https://redwoodinference.com

From: Asha Patel <asha.patel@finovatebank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Chris Morgan <chris.morgan@finovatebank.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Stakeholder mapping + next steps (FinovateBank)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the recap and the MAP — this is exactly what we need. A few confirmations from our side: 

- Economic buyer: Yes, Evan Briggs (CFO) will own budget approval. Evan’s email: evan.briggs@finovatebank.com
- Security: Head of InfoSec is Laura Ortega (laura.ortega@finovatebank.com). I’ll intro you both once we have the MAP updated.
- Procurement: procurement@finovatebank.com (I’ll loop in Raj from procurement after you share the formal SOW/pricing).

Timeline: procurement & security reviews typically take 3–4 weeks (procurement paperwork + SLA review). Our goal is a pilot in Q2 if the technical fit and pricing align.

Attachments I’m sending back: FinovateBank-RFP.pdf (procurement template) — it lists our standard contract and security expectations. Also tagging the specific items we want in the security packet: SOC 2 report, data retention policy, encryption at rest docs, and details on audit logging.

Two quick asks: 
- Can you share a 1-page ROI that calls out expected per-month token cost ranges and an example TCO for a pilot (30k monthly active users, 2 calls/user/day)?
- Could Naomi run the technical deep-dive with our platform team — target next Tue/Wed (morning PST) works for us.

Thanks — I’ll start building the stakeholder table and share an initial version by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Asha Patel
Senior Product Manager | FinovateBank
asha.patel@finovatebank.com

[Attachment: FinovateBank-RFP.pdf]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Asha Patel <asha.patel@finovatebank.com>, Chris Morgan <chris.morgan@finovatebank.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Stakeholder mapping + next steps (FinovateBank)

Thanks Asha — really helpful. I’m attaching a short SOC2 summary and a 1-page ROI that addresses the pilot sizing you called out. Also added an updated MAP with a suggested owner column filled in based on our conversation.

Champion enablement (talk track + quick equip for Asha):
- Opening line: “Redwood lets us reliably serve customer-facing LLM features with predictable unit economics and enterprise controls — so we can ship faster without sacrificing compliance.”
- Procurement talking points: clear pilot pricing, committed throughput during pilot, defined rollback and SLA terms; we offer a short-term credit for initial testing tied to mutually-agreed KPIs.
- Security talking points: SOC 2 Type II summary, audit log export capabilities, customer-managed KMS support for private deployments, and data retention controls.
- ROI snippet: For a 30k MAU pilot with 2 calls/user/day and average 50 tokens/response, expected token volume ~3M tokens/month. With typical batching + caching optimizations, estimated cost range: $X–$Y/month (see attached 1-pager for ranges and assumptions).

Proposed next steps:
1) Naomi to run a 45-min technical deep-dive with your platform & security leads — proposed slots: Tue 03/02 09:00–09:45 PST or Wed 03/03 11:00–11:45 PST.
2) I’ll prepare a short SOW and draft pricing for the pilot once we have the stakeholder table filled.
3) Asha to introduce Evan & Laura when you’re ready (helps speed approvals).

Attachments: SOC2-summary-2025.pdf, redwood-roi-1pager.pdf, MAP_FinovateBank_v1.xlsx (updated)

Let me know which deep-dive slot works and I’ll get calendar invites out.

Thanks,
Marissa
